name: Apocalyptic Shadow
detailed_description:
Background

Set in a fictional, post-apocalyptic Western Europe, players must venture into various zones—including apartment complexes, large supermarkets, city hospitals, research centers, and temporary shelters—to scavenge essential supplies.

However, once you leave the safety of your base and step into the desolate wastelands, the danger escalates rapidly. Each area in the game is home to unique and perilous biomes filled with threats. Players start with only basic gear and must rely on their wits and skill to find resources, fend off zombies, and—most importantly—make it back to the shelter alive.

Be warned: nuclear radiation has had unpredictable effects on local zombies and enemies, making them even more ferocious and deadly...

Exploration

By observing, experimenting, and exploring repeatedly, you’ll gradually uncover the secrets of the map’s layout and mechanics. But tread carefully—your primary goal is to return safely. Every expedition holds the potential for unique rewards: valuable loot, newly revealed paths, or hidden story clues. Get ready to face the unknown—because the wasteland never stops surprising you. Your courage and curiosity will unlock the unique secrets and treasures hidden in every corner of the map.

Combat

The world is still plagued by roaming zombie hordes, always ready to strike—so never let your guard down. But don’t lose hope! When your ammo is well-stocked, why not go all out in a thrilling purge? Unleash your heavy weapons and mow down enemies with overwhelming firepower. Imagine standing amidst a mountain of corpses, spraying bullets like fireworks, turning the battlefield into a chaotic testament of your dominance. Stay sharp, survive, and use your strength to forge a safer tomorrow.

Death

In this harsh, post-apocalyptic world, survival is everything. If your character dies, all accumulated gear and resources are lost. After all, only the living can continue the journey to a better tomorrow. Enduring and surviving—that’s the key to overcoming this brutal game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 Or Later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 4000 series or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 750 or equivalent, integrated graphics not supported
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit Recommended, 32-bit Supported

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4000 series or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 or equivalent, integrated graphics not supported
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
